data.headline: Two weeks unlimited. The only rookie mistake is not trying.
data.benefit: Two weeks unlimited for ₹3,999 (Bengaluru ₹2,999) and a spot on the Rookie leaderboard. The only rookie mistake is not starting.
data.rationale: Clients with 5+ visits in month one buy at 93.5%. A 14-day window lets newcomers reach 5+ visits; the race gives them a reason. Effective 20% on conversion.

data.benefit: Finished the race? Our medal detector just beeped: 6 months at 20% off plus a private, or 3 months at 15% off plus 5 days.
data.rationale: Race attendance lifts usage into the 75%+ band where renewal is 82–88%. August is Mumbai's second peak (Kwality ₹30.0L, Bandra ₹22.8L in Aug-26).

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One) in Momence (2027-08-01 to 2027-08-20): 14 days unlimited: Mumbai ₹3,999 (barre + powerCycle, 1 Lab induction at Supreme HQ), Kenkere ₹2,999 (barre), pop-ups ₹1,999 for 4 classes in 14 days.
